title: Tensor projection maps respect compact-support composition
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Work on the small etale sites with the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], exact constant-coefficient inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. All schemes mentioned are Noetherian [def-pc-scheme]. Compact-support direct image is the compactification-independent functor of [def-amb-etale-compact-support, lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Let $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z$ be separated finite-type morphisms admitting compactifications, and let $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K\in D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For each morphism $a$ write
$$P_{a,Q,B}:Q\otimes_A^LRa_!B\longrightarrow Ra_!(a^*Q\otimes_A^LB)$$
for the tensor projection map obtained from the termwise open-extension tensor map and the proper projection map [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-extension-tensor, def-kun-projection-formula-map]. Let $\alpha_{g,f}:Rg_!Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(gf)_!$ be the proper/open tower-normalized composition comparison of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Under $(gf)^*K=f^*g^*K$, the actual transformations satisfy
$$\alpha_{g,f,f^*g^*K\otimes M}\circ Rg_!(P_{f,g^*K,M})\circ P_{g,K,Rf_!M}
=P_{gf,K,M}\circ(1_K\otimes\alpha_{g,f,M}).$$
This identity includes compatibility with the proper/open interchange used in the tower and with the refinement comparisons. It holds on the whole ordinary derived categories, without boundedness or finite Tor-amplitude assumptions on $K,M$. Whenever the projection maps are invertible their inverses satisfy the equivalent identity.

proof.text: Use the existing right-factor compactification projection pi_c, proper projection followed by canonical derived open tensor extension and the compactification pullback comparison. The coefficient-first map in the unchanged definition is pi_c conjugated by the signed tensor symmetry and by the canonical left-derived to termwise pullback comparison.

Apply the explicit compactification-tower projection formula with d a compactification of g and e a compactification of f followed by d.i. That formula pastes the cartesian mixed square, proper projection composition and open tensor composition, with the actual proper/open tower compositor.

Transport the tower identity from e.restrict to the chosen compactification of f and from d.comp(e) to the chosen compactification of fg. Use the already proved source-library projectionMapOfCompactification_rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso, whose comparison is exactly the common-refinement isomorphism in the compact-support compositor. Naturality of the g projection moves the first comparison through the outer projection; naturality of the final comparison moves the coefficient map. Specialize to the compactifications in the definition of unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso. This replaces all of the original separate clopen-refinement calculation.

The canonical left-derived to exact termwise pullback comparisons respect composition: expand the two pullback compositors and cancel inverse comparisons, using naturality. Conjugate the right-factor projection identity by the three signed tensor symmetries. Naturality cancels the two middle swaps and transports the pullback comparison, giving precisely the unchanged coefficient-first equality with unboundedEtaleUpperStarCompIso explicit.

When the three projection arrows are isomorphisms, invert the proved equality. Functor maps preserve inverses; inversion reverses composition; the inverse of tensor applied to a pullback compositor is tensor applied to its inverse. Reassociate to obtain the second conjunct.

Keep the already proved comparison clause. Apply the existing right-factor compactification-independence square and transport it through tensor symmetry and the exact-pullback comparison by naturality. No new refinement or clopen calculation is needed.
